channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Derek Fisher | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Derek Fisher from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“It's a guy that personally, I don't f*ck with as an individual, but I'm going to give him his flowers as a hooper. When you talk about having that on and off switch, a 82-game versus a 16-game player for the post-season, that's f*cking Derek Fisher. Derek Fisher at times, majority of his career, would look like one of the worst point starting guards in the fucking league. When it was time for him to step up and go into the post-season, alongside Kobe and Shaq or alongside Kobe and Gasol, that motherf*cker stepped up to the plate.”

Kendrick Perkins on Derek Fisher, Sep 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jermaine O'Neal on Derek Fisher, Rick Fox
item.description:
Jermaine O'Neal:

“I remember asking some Lakers—Rick Fox, Derek Fisher—where Kobe was when they were out at a bar. They laughed and said, ‘He doesn’t go out. He stays in his room.’Early in his career, people said he wasn’t a great teammate, but the truth is, his teammates didn’t know him well. That was his makeup—he was always studying, always preparing. It created a perception that he didn’t want to be around the team. And in the NBA, we’re always around each other, so if you don’t see a teammate, it feels like he doesn’t want to be part of the group. But with Kobe, it was just focus—it wasn’t personal.”

Jermaine O'Neal on Derek Fisher, Rick Fox, Jul 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Melvin Hunt on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Hunt:

“Probably my favorite thing of all was watching him kind of evolve in front of us. When we first got to the Lakers, I’ll just say Kobe was not a great leader. He did not really know how to lead because he hadn’t really had to because he had so many great personalities and leaders around him. The leader of the Lakers at the time,people won’t say it, but it was Derek Fisher. He was kind of the guy that allowed Kobe to be Kobe. He was out front with a lot of things that needed to be said for the team.”

Melvin Hunt on Derek Fisher, Jan 26, 2021. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Derek Fisher
item.description:
“It was a big shock last year when Fisher got fired. I felt like we were working towards something and even though we were losing, we were moving forward and we had the structure so it was a shock for me. This year, [it’s] a similar situation with our record and where we stand right now but we can’t be worrying about what’s going to happen. As a player I have to be focused on what I need to do on the court every game and keep going day by day and game by game and not worry about the outside noise.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Derek Fisher, Feb 9, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Nick Young on Derek Fisher, Robert Horry
item.description:
Nick Young:

“Watching the Robert Horry shot, Kobe, Derek Fisher’s .4-second shot... Mine is kind of unique: I stole it from my own teammate.”

Nick Young on Derek Fisher, Robert Horry, Nov 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @KevinDing.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Geoff Calkins:Here's the Joerger quote on Barnes:

“I'm sure Matt didn't have a good day when pictures came out of his ex wife and Derek Fisher on TMZ.”

Matt Barnes on Derek Fisher, Mar 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @geoff_calkins.

item.title: Byron Scott on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Scott said on coaching firings.

“It really depends on what the GM and owners want. Some are unrealistic in some instances. I have no clue, to be honest with you about what most teams want. Fisher is a prime example. This business is very, very hard to deal with a times. But you have to deal with it. This is the chosen profession for us. You’re going to deal with sometimes getting fired unexpected and sometimes it’s warranted. You just have to deal with it.”

Byron Scott on Derek Fisher, Feb 8, 2016. Source: Los Angeles Daily News.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on the #Knicks firing coach Derek Fisher:

“I’m disappointed for him. I don’t know the specifics of their internal situation.”

Rick Carlisle on Derek Fisher, Feb 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Derek Fisher, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Royce Young:Durant on Porzingis:

“When they made the pick I texted [Derek Fisher] and immediately said I like this kid, he can play.”

Kevin Durant on Derek Fisher, Kristaps Porzingis, Jan 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Matt Barnes on Derek Fisher ahead of tonight's Knicks-Grizzlies game:

“I just don't like him. Plain and simple. He knows I don't like him.”

Matt Barnes on Derek Fisher, Jan 16, 2016. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher, Ronny Turiaf
item.description:
“It's very rare for me to open up to somebody like that, but I just had a connection with him. He's one of my favorite teammates. There's Caron, there's Pau [Gasol], there's [Derek Fisher] and Ronnie Turiaf.”

Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher, Ronny Turiaf, Nov 20, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Marc Davis on Derek Fisher
item.description:
According to head of officiating Marc Davis, Fisher — who was standing on the side of the court opposite the play — launched into profanity that resulted in a double technical.

“Fisher screamed, ‘F--- no.’ And then as I took one more step to report the foul, he said, ‘That’s f------ horrible,’”

Marc Davis on Derek Fisher, Nov 9, 2015. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Matt Barnes on fan reaction:

“With me, you never know. There's a handful of people who love me and a handful of people who hate me. And there's a handful of people who want to chant, 'Derek Fisher,' so it will be interesting.”

Matt Barnes on Derek Fisher, Nov 9, 2015. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Ian Begley:Carmelo on Fisher in Year 2:

“You can tell he’s more comfortable right now. He understands what he wants.... You can feel that aura.”

Carmelo Anthony on Derek Fisher, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher
item.description:
Kobe Bryant:

“There is two. [Shaq?] No it’s not Shaq. But I loved Shaq. Me and Shaq won the thing but I didn’t particularly like playing with him too much. [Laughs] It’s easy. It’s Derek Fisher and Pau Gasol.”

Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher, Jul 13, 2015. Source: The Kobe Team.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Nearly halfway through the season, the Warriors are at the top, the Knicks under Derek Fisher are at the bottom.

“I totally feel for [Fisher]. The NBA is a roller coaster. It’s really fun when you win, really devastating when you lose,”

Steve Kerr on Derek Fisher, Jan 11, 2015. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Chris Herring:Melo, on the job Fisher's done to keep the team together despite 5-29:

“I think a lot of other guys would have crumbled under that.”

Carmelo Anthony on Derek Fisher, Dec 31, 2014. Source: Twitter @HerringWSJ.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Quixem Ramirez:Pop on Derek Fisher's head coaching gig:

“He knows what it takes to win or lose. There's no reason he can't be successful.”

Gregg Popovich on Derek Fisher, Jun 10, 2014. Source: Twitter @quixem.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Kobe Bryant:

“My all time favorite teammate has always been Derek Fisher. He’s been my favorite teammate, I would love to see him back in a Lakers uniform so we could kind of finish out together.”

Kobe Bryant on Derek Fisher, Sep 26, 2013. Source: NBCSports.com.

item.title: Jordan Farmar on Phil Jackson, Derek Fisher
item.description:
“Phil Jackson was very comfortable with Derek Fisher staying in the role that he had been playing. I just felt at that point, after four years in the NBA and two rings, that my role wasn't going to be changingand I was playing the same role. I needed to give myself a chance to grow, or at least to give myself a shot and see what could happen.”

Jordan Farmar on Phil Jackson, Derek Fisher, Sep 6, 2013. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Tony Allen on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Royce Young:Tony Allen:

“We're going to have to scout Derek Fisher more and see where he was killing us.”

Tony Allen on Derek Fisher, May 8, 2013. Source: Twitter @dailythunder.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Derek Fisher
item.description:
Bryan Gutierrez:Carlisle on Fisher:

“He’s probably going to be our starting point guard. We’ve got a great situation with him and Collison.”

Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Derek Fisher, Nov 30, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Ramona Shelbourne:Kobe Bryant on Derek Fisher, who hasn't signed with a team yet:

“I'm pretty confident he'll find a team. Every team needs a guard like him.”

Kobe Bryant on Derek Fisher, Oct 11, 2012. Source: Twitter @ramonashelburne.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Dudley, the Suns' team representative, told SI.com recently.

“Derek Fisher wanted an audit. He wanted to know what's going on with the money and all of that. From the inside -- and I'm on the inside with the players -- it sounds fishy after the lockout that you want our president to leave, a president who's auditing the head chairman.”

Jared Dudley on Derek Fisher, Sep 20, 2012. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Maurice Evans on Derek Fisher
item.description:
“We have already expressed what our desires are as a board. We didn’t expect this from Derek, with the leadership he has displayed in the past, and it was becoming a huge distraction from the great season that the NBA is having right now. The executive committee understands that we don’t make decisions as individuals. We make decisions as a whole. This is not about Mo Evans, Billy Hunter or Derek Fisher. This is about us making decisions collectively and when we don’t demonstrate that desire to make decisions as a group, we think it’s in the best interest to part ways.”

Maurice Evans on Derek Fisher, Apr 21, 2012. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Derek Fisher
item.description:
“We have a great corps of point guards leading off with Russ and then Reggie and Royal. But adding another guy that can come in and give us some good minutes here and there and bring his leadership and winning plays here would be cool. But it's one of those things that you really don't know too much about. We got to just see what happens.(Fisher) is a Thunder guy as far as character and off the court is concerned. But we'll see what happens.”

Kevin Durant on Derek Fisher, Mar 20, 2012. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Bill Clinton on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Ken Berger:Clinton on Derek Fisher:

“I have a lot of confidence in him. He's a good man.”

Bill Clinton on Derek Fisher, Nov 8, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Andray Blatche on Derek Fisher
item.description:
Blatche said he’s still hopeful, but he’s also concerned that the NBA season could be in jeopardy.

“I have a lot of confidence in [players’ union president] Derek Fisher. I believe that he and the [executive committee] team are working hard to get things resolved soon,”

Andray Blatche on Derek Fisher, Nov 7, 2011. Source: Washington Times.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Derek Fisher
item.description:
“But I don't want him negotiating my contract. I want an agent who knows the lingo negotiating my contract. Derek Fisher, he doesn't negotiate his own contract. He has an agent. So why would I want him negotiating something even bigger than his contract? This [Collective Bargaining Agreement] is something more important to everybody.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Derek Fisher, Nov 3, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Derek Fisher
item.description:
“He's one of the greatest commissioners in sports. He's got that title, he's got the NBA at the place where it is because he's a shrewd businessman and knows how to work his way, play the media, play things up to get what he wants. We don't do that. Players are emotional. Players get emotional. So no, I don't necessarily, particularly want Derek Fisher or any of the executive committee negotiating a contract for me.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Derek Fisher, Nov 3, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.
